specification: Exact production replay over an arbitrary candidate whose writes obey the trait contract: success is exactly viewport, each carried identity still admitted, hover, one resolve, then pointer and frame cache adoption, with no write of an unadmitted identity; None only follows a failed write. NativeScene's trait implementation, the assumption that its writes leave the admission gates unchanged, and everything Blitz does in those writes are outside the proof.

Verus+Z3.note: Six controls are rejected at an intermediate assertion or at the guarded call rather than at the postcondition.

Proptest.includes: the real kernel against an independently written script, and candidate writes that unwind

harness: memory boundaries: every failure and panic position

cargo-fuzz.note: no-panic path only; the two counts are read_boundary and batch_decode, and only read_boundary reaches this kernel

Kani.note: carried values, both admission masks and the failure position symbolic; Kani has no unwinding model

Loom.reason: The kernel holds no shared state and no synchronization primitive; the candidate is exclusively owned by the construction stage until it is committed.
Loom.substitute_evidence: None added. It is not a concurrency proof.

real_scene_test.covers: Real NativeScene and real Blitz document, read back from the replaced view: window size and scale, scroll, press, hover, focus, pointer and frame cache; hiding both identities drops them while the frame still commits.
real_scene_test.mutation_checked: Nine manual mutations of the NativeScene trait implementation each made it fail (one run each, not in the Verus control table): no viewport, no scroll, no press, no focus, no hover, no stored pointer, no stored frame cache, press always admitted, focus always admitted.
